Baopu (抱樸) with brother Baozhi in s0014 aligns with anchor liaoshi:010:p083 邢抱樸. Variant 朴/樸 dossiers are orthography, not evidence of a different son.
Commissioner Yelü Yixin (樞密使耶律乙辛) in s0039–s0055 matches liaoshi:021:p042 anchor. Xiao Hudu dossier is a different man; chapter 乙辛 consistently names Yelü Yixin.

Titles 上/帝/陛下 in Baoning–Dakang narrative (s0038, s0057–s0062) denote Liao emperors in accepted cluster; anchor liaoshi:018:p066 皇子洪基 does not contradict. Overflow 道宗/查剌 dossiers are not separation evidence.
Lu Yanlun (盧彥倫) in Yixin’s prophecy of rebellion (s0068) matches anchor liaoshi:029:p084 上京盧彥倫. Repeated romanization dossiers are not separation proof.
邢簡 (簡) appears as Chen’s husband in s0008, s0011, and the chapter register s0001, matching anchor liaoshi:080:p009 簡. No contradictory second Xing Jian actor.
Princess Hudu (胡獨公主) as Yixin’s mother in s0048; chapter-only primary.
Empress Dowager Ruizhi (睿智皇后) in s0016, s0096 matches liaoshi:061:p039 anchor; not conflated with another empress in these units.
State Uncle Commandant-escort Taosuwo (陶蘇斡) in s0047 is Yixin’s father; unique chapter reference.
Lady Xiao childhood name 意辛/意幸 in s0047, s0051, etc. is Yelü Nu’s wife Taosuwo’s daughter; single coherent biography. Accept retained assignment.
Song Bo Ji (宋伯姬) in s0005 matches anchor hanshu:104:p123 宋伯姬 as Springs-and-Autumn exemplum; no false merge with unrelated Song women.
Grand Preceptor Shilu (適魯) is Changge’s elder brother in s0019; s0042 kinship reference names him. Chapter-local single Shilu.

Yelü clanswoman Changge (常哥) is sister of Grand Preceptor Shilu (s0019) with poems to Yixin and remonstrance under regency (s0039, s0096). Header candidates Xiao Changge/Hudujin lack primary attestation in this chapter; preserve cross-corpus uncertainty.
Guoyin (國隱) as Yixin’s son in s0067 continues the same family line.
Xing Baozhi (抱質) as chancellor in s0014, s0057 matches liaoshi:015:p037 邢抱質 anchor. Accept with orthographic uncertainty on 貭/質 headers.
Yelü Shuzhe/朮者/術者 in s0072, s0078 aligns with anchor liaoshi:020:p024 耶律朮者. Other-chapter 术者 diviners are not primary in this chapter; bounded candidates remain uncertain.
Heir-apparent titles 皇太子/太子/皇儲 (s0041, s0056) match liaoshi:104:p019 anchor and Yixin–Yixin plot; missingBlockingName leaves identity open but no concrete false merge.
Wei Gong Jiang (衛共姜) in s0005 is a classical citation only; no conflation with chapter actors.

Liaoshi 107 treats Xing Jian’s wife Lady Chen (陳氏): learning, teaching her sons, and advising Empress Dowager Ruizhi on clemency (s0008, s0010, s0096). One chapter-local actor; accepted singleton membership stands.
Yelü Nu (奴) is husband of Lady Xiao Yixin in s0047–s0061, consistent with the Yixin exile narrative. No wrong-actor merge in chapter source.
Wife of Yelü Shuzhe with childhood name 訛裏本 in s0070, linked to birth of Prince Hongji. Xiao Chouwo header is not attested here; retain unresolvedIdentity on retrieval headers only.
Father 陘 of Lady Chen (s0009) as Chen clan official in Five Dynasties matches 陳陘 structure. Descriptor-only English header candidates do not separate him from the chapter father.
Yelü Zhong (中) in office and martyr death (s0090, s0093) is one continuous actor; no second Zhong false merge.
Lady Xiao Ruolan (挼蘭), wife of Yelü Zhong (s0083, s0092), consistent descent from King Hui of Han in the same unit. Accept membership.
King Hui of Han (韓國王惠) in s0083 as Ruolan’s ancestor; single attestation.
